metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1922 · Häxan

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1922 · Nanook of the North
metas.description: In this silent predecessor to the modern documentary, film-maker Robert J. Flaherty spends one year following the lives of Nanook and his family, Inuits living in the Arctic Circle.
